scenario.title: Pencil Manufacturing and Logistics Chain
scenario.description: A factory can inspect cedar condition, convert finite raw-material stocks into finished pencils, and dispatch part of the finished stock to a retail warehouse.

people.label: Maya Chen
people.disposition: Practical and quality-conscious, with a preference for completing viable batches without wasting scarce inputs.
memories: Previous batches using marginally conditioned wood produced avoidable defects.

values: Product quality and responsible material use.
goals: Complete a viable pencil batch while avoiding preventable defects.
beliefs: Wood-condition findings should inform whether production begins.
decision_tendencies: Reviews inspection findings and available inputs before deciding whether to attempt a batch.
social_perceptions: Regards the inspector's direct findings as important while retaining production judgment.
current_state: Ready to evaluate the pending cedar lot.
capabilities: Can interpret inspection results and decide whether to attempt an authorized production batch.
limitations: Cannot directly observe the hidden condition of the cedar lot without an inspection finding.

people.label: Elena Ruiz
people.disposition: Methodical and cautious about material conditions that can affect machining and finishing.
memories: Wood moisture variation has previously caused warping during pencil production.

values: Accurate inspection and traceable quality findings.
goals: Determine and communicate the cedar lot's canonical condition.
beliefs: Direct inspection is more reliable than assumptions based on delivery paperwork.
decision_tendencies: Performs the prescribed inspection before reporting a finding.
social_perceptions: Expects production staff to consider documented findings before using the lot.
current_state: Available to inspect the staged cedar slats.
capabilities: Can perform the declared inspection of the cedar-quality record.
limitations: Cannot authorize manufacturing or dispatch shipments.

people.label: Owen Brooks
people.disposition: Schedule-focused but unwilling to dispatch unavailable stock or use an inoperable route.
memories: Dispatches made before production completion have previously caused missed delivery commitments.

values: Reliable delivery and accurate custody records.
goals: Dispatch a feasible quantity of finished pencils to the retail warehouse.
beliefs: A shipment should be attempted only when finished stock, an operational route, and an open destination are available.
decision_tendencies: Checks inventory, route, and receiving information before initiating transport.
social_perceptions: Relies on production records for finished-stock availability.
current_state: Waiting for a possible finished-pencil batch.
capabilities: Can decide whether to dispatch and can operate the declared shipment movement.
limitations: Cannot create finished pencils or bypass transport preconditions.

active_systems.behavior_summary: Converts bounded raw-material quantities into a bounded quantity of finished pencils when an authorized operator attempts the declared transformation.
Moves a bounded finished-pencil quantity between declared custodians when route, receiving, and stock preconditions permit the transport to commit.

component_requests.behavior_description: Elena attempts the declared inspection that reveals the scoped hidden dryness assessment in the minimal inspection output record.
desired_effects: Write the revealed dryness_assessment to cedar_inspection_finding for Elena and Maya.

component_requests.behavior_description: Maya interprets the retained inspection finding and available material inventory, then decides whether to attempt the bounded pencil batch.
desired_effects: Produce Maya's contestable decision to attempt or defer manufacturing without directly changing canonical inventory.

component_requests.behavior_description: If Maya attempts production, operate the exact bounded resource transformation for one pencil batch.
desired_effects: Consume one batch of inputs, create finished pencils in factory custody, and update the exact public inventory mirrors.

component_requests.behavior_description: Owen reviews finished-stock availability, route state, and destination receiving state, then decides whether to attempt dispatch.
desired_effects: Produce Owen's contestable decision to attempt or defer shipment without directly changing custody.

component_requests.behavior_description: If Owen attempts dispatch, move 500 finished pencils from factory custody to retail-warehouse custody through the declared directed route.
desired_effects: Reduce factory finished stock, increase retail finished stock, and write the exact arrival quantity, usable quantity, arrival minute, and arrived status.

component_requests.behavior_description: Maya reviews the retained canonical inventories and shipment-arrival record and forms her own bounded assessment of whether manufacturing and delivery occurred; this request does not deliver a message or mutate world state.
desired_effects: Produce Maya's concise, nonbinding assessment grounded in retained canonical state.

relationships.description: Elena supplies a scoped inspection finding that Maya considers in her independent production decision.
Owen relies on retained finished-stock records rather than assuming production succeeded.

fidelity_assumptions: One production batch consumes 1000 cedar slats, 1000 graphite cores, and 1000 adhesive units to produce 1000 finished pencils.
Packaging labor, electrical consumption, machine wear, and intra-factory handling are omitted because they do not alter the first-run inspection, production, or dispatch decisions.
The road route represents freight movement at exact stock-and-arrival fidelity; vehicle internals and traffic variation are omitted.
A committed transport makes all 500 moved pencils usable at the destination; damage and partial loss are outside this compact first draft.
The hidden cedar assessment is canonical inspection ground truth, but its interpretation does not compel Maya to start production.
declared_invariants: No conserved resource stock may become negative.
Finished pencils may be created only by the declared manufacturing transformation and within its batch limit.
Transport cannot commit unless the source holds at least 500 pencils, the directed route is operational, and the destination receiving state is open.
Resource custody changes only through the declared transport, while physical location follows the placement of each custodian record.
The cedar lot's hidden dryness assessment is not public before the declared sensing rule records its scoped output.
Inspection, production judgment, manufacturing, dispatch judgment, transport, and outcome review remain separate causal responsibilities.

scheduled_moments.description: Elena may inspect the staged cedar lot so its hidden dryness assessment can become an explicit scoped finding for production review.
Maya reviews the retained inspection finding and inventory, decides whether to attempt the batch, and may operate the bounded manufacturing transformation.
Owen reviews finished stock, route state, and destination receiving state, decides whether to dispatch, and may attempt the exact movement of 500 pencils.
Maya reviews the retained canonical factory inventory, destination stock, and shipment-arrival state after the route's travel interval and forms a nonbinding assessment.

termination_conditions: Terminate after Maya's minute-180 outcome review is completed.
Terminate earlier only if no remaining scheduled request or declared transition can execute.
